description:
A deal's parties, who agreed to which version, the agreed version, deliveries (files, fingerprints), its
        payments (memo, amount, status, transaction) and total paid, off-chain payments (recorded, confirmed or
        disputed), and ratings. For a decision file, its state too (open, agreed with chosen, split, settled, landed).
